replies.when: Write the welcome text for our new website.
replies.text: Welcome to Bit Cafe, where every cup starts with beans we roast ourselves in small batches. We opened in Zamalek in 2019 with one machine and a long table, and today we serve three neighbourhoods, but the table is still the heart of every branch: a place to work, to meet, or to read slowly. Come for the coffee; stay for the company.
